# Mosquito Simulator: Bite & Run

> Mosquito Simulator: Bite & Run is a free iPhone game in which you play as a mosquito. You fly at insect scale through 20 realistic rooms, land on sleeping people, hold the bite for the golden moment, dodge slaps in slow motion and fly out of the window before dawn. It came out on the App Store on 9 November 2026.

Facts as of 24 November 2026:
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 15.0 or later. Android: not announced.
- Price: free download with optional in-app purchases (Mosquito Club US$4.99/month or US$29.99/year; items US$0.99–19.99).
- Released: 2026-11-09 (version 1.0). Developer and publisher: Ali Mert Güleç (independent).
- Story: 20 nights in 4 chapters (June–September) with 2 boss nights (Racket Uncle, Pest Control).
- Modes: Story, Daily Night, Game of the Week, Sleepless Night (endless), Online 1 vs 3 (one human vs three mosquitoes; bots fill empty seats).
- 10 playable real mosquito species: Culex, Aedes aegypti, Anopheles, Asian tiger (Aedes albopictus), gallinipper (Psorophora ciliata), Culiseta, Wyeomyia, Deinocerites, Sabethes cyaneus, Toxorhynchites.
- Game languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Arabic. Age rating 9+. Download about 393 MB.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6827985347
- Support: https://amert9696.github.io/mosquito-site/support/ · Privacy: https://amert9696.github.io/mosquito-site/privacy.html · Terms: https://amert9696.github.io/mosquito-site/terms.html
